args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with elevated error rate (0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production version was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out`), and the service is now **healthy** with error rate back down to 0.002.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.
